summary: Konami's large-party political-fantasy JRPG series, including the five mainline console RPGs, Japan-only narrative and card spin-offs, the PS2 tactics side game, DS and PSP alternate-world entries, and the modern Suikoden I & II HD remaster routes.

entries.title: Suikoden
entries.definitive_edition: Suikoden I & II HD Remaster for the main run; Sega Saturn as secondary extras

emulation.emulator: Mednafen or Kronos for Saturn extras; DuckStation for original PlayStation comparison
emulation.notes: Keep PC HD remaster as the main route. Use Saturn emulation only for exclusive-content cleanup.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC HD remaster output, plus upscaled Saturn/PS1 comparison routes.

primary.version: Suikoden I & II HD Remaster: Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
primary.why: The 2025 PC remaster has the highest modern fidelity for the first game, with HD backgrounds, updated effects, enhanced sound, auto-save, fast-forward, and conversation-log quality-of-life features. The Saturn version has exclusive extras, so it is a secondary cleanup route rather than the main full playthrough.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam/Windows release of Suikoden I & II HD Remaster at native display resolution. If you want the missing Saturn-exclusive extras afterward, use a legally dumped Japanese Saturn disc in Mednafen or Kronos.

secondary.exclusive_content: Enhanced Saturn port content including new locations, enemies, colors, opening FMV, and documented extra items/events/minigames that are not part of the HD remaster.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the Saturn-exclusive scenes/areas/minigames after the HD remaster route.
secondary.why: The Saturn port is more complete in specific extras, but the PC HD remaster is the higher-fidelity full-playthrough version.

entries.remaster_caveats: The HD remaster improves presentation and quality-of-life but does not replace the Saturn version for its exclusive extras.

entries.title: Suikoden II

emulation.notes: Use DuckStation only for the original PS1 presentation; use the PC remaster for the main run.

primary.version: Suikoden I & II HD Remaster: Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
primary.why: The 2025 PC remaster is the highest-fidelity official route for Suikoden II, adding HD backgrounds, redrawn portraits, enhanced sound, fast-forward, and other quality-of-life features while preserving the complete core game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam/Windows HD remaster at native resolution. Use a Suikoden I clear save within the remaster if you want the intended continuity bonuses.

entries.remaster_caveats: The remaster modernizes presentation and quality-of-life without documented separate exclusive content requiring another route.

entries.title: Genso Suikogaiden Vol. 1: Swordsman of Harmonia

emulation.notes: Use PlayStation emulation for clean capture of the Japan-only original.

primary.why: This Japan-only Suikoden visual novel was released on PlayStation and has no documented official port or remaster, so accurate PlayStation emulation is the highest-fidelity preservation route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped Japanese PlayStation disc image in DuckStation with PGXP and internal-resolution scaling as desired; expect Japanese text unless using a separately sourced translation patch.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official English release, port, or remaster is documented.

entries.title: Genso Suikoden Card Stories

emulation.notes: Use integer scaling and original GBA aspect ratio.

primary.why: The Card Stories video game is a Japan-only GBA strategy/card spin-off with no documented official port; mGBA gives the best clean capture route for the single official release.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped GBA cartridge image in mGBA with integer scaling. Expect Japanese text unless using a separately sourced translation patch.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official port or remaster is documented.

emulation.notes: Use internal-resolution scaling and conservative widescreen settings; verify UI/FMV framing.

primary.why: Suikoden III is a PS2 game with a later PSN PS2 Classics route; PCSX2 offers the highest-fidelity capture path through internal-resolution scaling and deinterlacing while preserving the complete original game.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS2 disc image in PCSX2 with high internal resolution, deinterlacing, widescreen only if verified safe, and original FMV aspect where appropriate.

primary.why: Suikoden IV was released exclusively for PlayStation 2; PCSX2 is therefore the highest-fidelity way to play the complete original game.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS2 disc image in PCSX2 with high internal resolution and deinterlacing. Keep the original presentation unless a widescreen patch is verified safe.

primary.why: Suikoden Tactics is a PS2 tactical RPG set around Suikoden IV with no documented port or remaster, so PCSX2 is the highest-fidelity complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS2 disc image in PCSX2 with high internal resolution and deinterlacing.

primary.why: Suikoden V was released for PlayStation 2 and has no documented official port or remaster; PCSX2 gives the highest-fidelity complete route for streaming.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS2 disc image in PCSX2 with high internal resolution, deinterlacing, and conservative widescreen settings only if verified safe.

entries.title: Suikoden Tierkreis

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Clean DS output with flexible screen arrangement.

primary.why: Tierkreis is a Nintendo DS spin-off with no documented port or remaster, so DS emulation is the best route for clean capture of the complete game.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped DS cartridge image in melonDS, configure the two-screen layout for stream readability, and preserve the original touch-screen interactions.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official port or remaster is documented.
